# clavis upgrade

<p class="cli-lead">Verify a signed release artifact and install it</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis upgrade ARTIFACT [flags]
```

</div>

Verify a downloaded release archive with cosign before installing it.
Needs `cosign` on your `PATH` and the release's `.sigstore.json` bundle
next to the archive.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">Verify only</p>

```sh
clavis upgrade clavis_linux_amd64.tar.gz
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Verify and replace the current binary</p>

```sh
clavis upgrade clavis_linux_amd64.tar.gz --install
```
